articles.title: The Universe's Secret Recipe for Life Might Be Hidden in a Glass of Water
articles.summary: New research suggests the fundamental constants of physics are tuned not just for stars, but for the flow of liquids inside living cells. A tiny shift could make blood too thick for life.

articles.title: That Viral Pet IQ Test? It's a Reflex, Not a Sign of Genius
articles.summary: The TikTok wall test for dogs and cats is misleading, say animal cognition researchers. It's a neurological reflex, not an intelligence measure, and holding pets that way can distress them.

articles.title: A 'Counter-Intuitive' Steel Could Unlock Cheap Green Hydrogen from Seawater
articles.summary: HKU researchers developed a stainless steel that resists corrosion at ultra-high voltages, using a surprising manganese-based second layer. It could slash electrolyzer costs by 40 times.
